bt: The sky is clear this morning. Anyone who drives facing east drives with the head [?ngekhanda].
There is not even a single cloud all day long. One tree in the parking area is now the place everyone wants.
It is very sunny. Except in your garden.
Since breakfast time the sky has looked like it is going to rain. It still just looks that way.
The sun did not come to the sundowners. All the others arrived.
A little breeze brings the smoke of the neighbour's braai. You get everything except the meat.
There is a proper wind tonight. The mosquitoes cannot land.
Lovely rain. Grandfather is already phoning everyone: 'How much did you get?'
It rains all night. The sprinkler has not noticed that yet.
The sun comes out and goes in all day, and then it is like this. We all know a person like that.
The sky is clear this morning. Anyone who drives towards the east drives with the head [?ngentloko].
There is not even another cloud all day. The only tree in the parking area is now the place everyone wants.
It is sunny for the most part. Except in your garden.
Since breakfast it looks as if it is going to rain. It still just looks that way.
The sun did not come to the sundowners. All the others arrived.
A little wind brings the smoke of the neighbours' braai. You get everything except the meat.
There is enough wind tonight. The [?iingcongconi - small flying insects/mosquitoes?] cannot come down.
Lovely rain. Grandfather is already phoning [?tsalela] everyone: 'How much did you get?'
It rains all night. The sprinkler has not yet noticed.
The sun comes out and goes in all day, and now this thing. We all know a person like that.
